description:
The CA-520 3 speed is a new age style cruiser, a cross between a traditional cruiser frame and a hybrid bicycle. Equipped with coaster brakes this men's bicycle is great for beach side, city, or neighborhood riding. The Shimano Nexus 3 Speed is a simple and clean bicycle gear system. It shifts easily with the twist of the wrist and the three speeds are enough for casual riders looking to ride anywhere from 0 - 15 miles per ride. This men's cruiser bike has features a coaster brake which engages when the rider pedals backwards.

The CA-520 3 speed is a three speed cruiser bike, which has an internal gear system located inside the rear wheel. This gear system has only one cable that runs from the handlebar shifter to the rear wheel. The cable is neatly tucked under the frame to keep the bike looking clean. It is simple and easy to use and will require little to no maintenance at all. The shifter is located by the right handlebar grip and the rider simply twists the grip to change speeds. Internal 3 speed bikes can function properly for many years without ever doing any maintenance at all. Riding up hills with the CA-520 3 Speed Bike won’t pose any problems; the different speeds will give you varying degrees of resistance to make the uphill climb easier.

The riding position of this bike keeps the rider's back in a straight upright position. In addition, the pedals are shifted forward to allow riders to be closer to the ground while still getting great leg extension. This is a great men's bicycle for cruising, commuting or exercising.

17” Extended Length Aluminum Frame

3 Speed Mens’ Bike with Shimano Internal Gear System, shifts quickly, easily, and requires little maintenance

Great recreational riding bike for taller men or those who would like more leg and arm extension. 4” extended frame creates more space between rider and handlebars.

Forward pedaling design allows riders to keep seat closer to ground while still getting proper leg extension

Frame Geometry makes riders feels less cramped, creating a more “kicked back” “relaxed” ride

Circular, High Arching Top Tube Frame Design

Dual Spring Oversized Seat for Added Comfort

2.125” Wide White-Wall Tires provide a cushioned, relaxed ride for easy rolling

25.5” Wide Chrome Plated Cruiser Bike Handlebars with Synthetic Leather Grips

Bicycle Weighs 43lbs. Fully Assembled

Fits Most Men 5’4” – 6’4” Tall

Recommended Riding Speed 3 – 25mph

Recommended Riding Distance 0 – 35miles in a single trip

The Seat and Handlebar Height and Tilt can be adjusted to properly fit the rider

Bike comes 80% Assembled, Assembly is easy and fun!

Designed in Hermosa Beach, CA.
